{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing 'body_mass_g' values
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = df_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Also compute and print the number of non-missing values
n_non_missing = len(df_clean)

print(mean_body_mass)
print(n_non_missing)"}
